items.title: Carpina (PE) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #1
items.en_title: Carpina (PE) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 19 #1
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Carpina (PE) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 4,500,000; proposals close Nov 19, 18:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
